newsitem.title: LATVIA: KAIJA ON OFFICIAL LIST WITHIN 30 DAYS.
newsitem.headline: KAIJA ON OFFICIAL LIST WITHIN 30 DAYS.

text.p: Kaija fish cannery said on Friday that it is going to hand in its listing prospectus to the bourse next week and the stock exchange said it could appear on the official list of the bourse withing 30 days.
"We are going to do that next week but the day is still to be agreed upon," Arno Karklinsh, board chairman, told Reuters.
Kaija share issue prospectus has been approved by the state securities commission.
Riga stock exchange said that the prospectus would be dealt with as soon as possible, quicker than the mandatory 30 days.
"The board will try to look it through as soon as possible," Uldis Cerps, stock exchange president, told a news conference.
"Kaija is a profitable business with potential and perspectives and I know that we are able to stand shoulder to shoulder with Staburadze for example," Kaija manager Andris Freimanis told Reuters.
